notes.title: Notice - Termination of Service
notes.notes:
Dear ZaBaTa! Community,

We regretfully announce, with a heavy heart, that ZaBaTa's journey will come to an end on July 28, 2023. 

We sincerely apologize for bringing you this disappointing news. 

Players who made in-app purchases after ZaBaTa's transition to free-to-play can request for refund until August 9th, 2023.

Your support since our Early Access has been a tremendous source of strength for our team. 

We are grateful for that support and deeply apologize once again for the termination of the game service. 

Sincerely, 

ZaBaTa! Team

notes.title: ZaBaTa! is Going Free-to-Play
notes.notes:
Dear, ZaBaTa! Community,



After careful consideration, we have made the decision to transition ZaBaTa! into a Free-to-Play game starting from May 24th, 2023 to make ZaBaTa! more accessible and enjoyable for a larger number of players. (In-app purchases will remain the same.)



We would like to express our sincere gratitude to those who supported us since the start of the Early Access. Your support has been meaningful and we appreciate your contributions to ZaBaTa! As a way to say thank you, we will be distributing 100,000 Gold as a reward to those who purchased the Early Access packages. 



As always, we welcome your feedback and encourage you to share your thoughts with us. Your input is an essential part of helping us shape the future of ZaBaTa! and we look forward to hearing what you have to say. 



Thank you for your understanding and continued support during this time of change. We hope you will join us in this new chapter and look forward to seeing you in-game. 




Sincerely, 

ZaBaTa! Team
